summary: Frontend-only test of the new /privacy page and links to it. Every requested check passed: page loads logged out; the index links scroll to each section (top offset 96px, which matches scroll-mt-24); all 4 provider cards (openai, emergent, postmark, stripe) show the extra-EU / Standard Contractual Clauses wording; 6 highlighted '[da completare: ...]' placeholders; no ISO, 'proprietaria' or exact-location wording. The admin draft notice is hidden when logged out, for the doctor and for the parent, and shown for the admin. The MantAI link opens /privacy#fornitori in a new tab and lands on the providers section. The landing footer link, both register-page links (new tab), the Indietro button and the home link work. At 390px provider cards stack in one column with no horizontal overflow. MantAI regression: Esc closes the dialog. No page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminNotice uses api.me() (/auth/me). The axios interceptor skips refresh for /auth/* URLs, so an admin whose access token has expired but whose refresh token is still valid will not see the draft notice until the session is refreshed elsewhere. Optional fix: call api.refresh() and retry when me() returns 401.
The admin notice is hidden only on the client (its text is in the public JS bundle). Acceptable because the text is not sensitive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logins done via page.request.post /api/auth/login (cookies are shared with the browser context). Credentials are in /app/memory/test_credentials.md; 2FA is off. The admin can view /privacy directly after an API login. The browser clock in the test env shows Oct 2026, so 'giugno 2026' is not a future date there.
